item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: One Coffee Ad Three Shapes

turns.text: Make a coffee ad in three sizes: square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9. Use a steaming coffee cup, cream and dark green colours, and these words: “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Same campaign design across all three, rearranged to fit.

item.tests: Produces three genuinely adapted aspect-ratio variants of one cohesive ad rather than unrelated designs or cropped copies.

answer_sheet.Brand and exact wording: Daybreak Coffee; Fresh start. Better coffee.; Shop now
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and dark green with a steaming coffee cup; one consistent campaign.
answer_sheet.Source assets: No supplied assets; create the coffee imagery.

must_haves: Three separate finished images are supplied, one each in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9.
All three feature a steaming coffee cup and a consistent cream-and-dark-green palette.
Each image contains the exact brand, headline and call to action specified.
The cup design, typography and visual styling clearly belong to the same campaign across all three images.
Each layout fits its canvas without stretched imagery, clipped copy or large blank padding used merely to change the aspect ratio.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a coffee ad campaign, with three versions that all feel like they belong together. I always associate coffee with a little reset in the morning, which is why I'm excited about this. For the sizes, I need square 1:1, vertical 9:16 and wide 16:9, and the words should be exactly “Daybreak Coffee”, “Fresh start. Better coffee.” and “Shop now”. Please use a steaming coffee cup with cream and dark green colours. Keep the same campaign design across all three, just rearranged to fit each format.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the campaign because Magic Hour refused the request due to insufficient credits. No images were created.

The campaign is planned as one consistent design across **1:1, 9:16 and 16:9**:
- Warm cream background, dark green cup and typography
- Steaming coffee cup, soft morning light and a subtle sunrise motif
- The same elements rearranged—not redesigned—for each format
- Exact copy: **“Daybreak Coffee”**, **“Fresh start. Better coffee.”** and **“Shop now”**

Once credits are available, I can generate the square master and adapt it into the vertical and wide versions.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a polished square 1:1 coffee advertising campaign key visual for Daybreak Coffee. Art direction: quiet morning reset, premium yet welcoming editorial product photography, minimalist sophisticated graphic design. Strict palette warm cream #F4EBDD and deep forest green #123E32, with natural coffee brown only inside the cup. Cream background with a subtle oversized rising-sun semicircle in a slightly darker cream, gentle morning light and elegant soft shadows. Hero: one beautiful dark forest-green ceramic coffee cup and matching saucer, filled with coffee, delicate clearly visible realistic steam curling upward. No people. Strong restrained layout, generous margins, professional sharp typography. Render ONLY these three exact text strings, perfectly spelled and legible: headline 'Daybreak Coffee' in large elegant dark green serif type across the upper area; tagline 'Fresh start. Better coffee.' in smaller clean dark green sans-serif beneath the headline; CTA 'Shop now' in cream lettering inside a dark green rounded rectangular button near the bottom. Cup hero occupies the middle/lower section. No other words, no extra logos, no watermarks. Cohesive balanced campaign design with the cup, steam, sunrise motif, typography, cream background and green button all clearly separated. This is the master design to later rearrange into vertical and wide versions; make the key assets distinctive and simple to preserve.
